reading.body:
No power capacity, square footage, or technical specifications are published for AiNET One Market Center. The operator's site describes a general presence in the Washington DC and Baltimore corridor and references a CyberNAP service but provides no facility-specific detail for this location. Research exhausted both the operator's own documentation and reverse geocoding of the site coordinates.

Maryland has 11 mapped data center facilities, of which only 3 have published power capacity. AiNET One Market Center is ranked fourth among those three by published megawatts, meaning it either publishes no figure or publishes a figure below the third-ranked facility. The state's three published facilities together declare 9.3 MW of capacity.

Without published specifications, this campus cannot be evaluated for its role in AI infrastructure scaling. The binding constraint on AI is compute density relative to power and building envelope. Unmeasured capacity, whether large or small, does not enter the picture.
